mascot: Macroscale Structural Connectomes via Tractography

Source: R/mascot-package.R
mascot-package.Rd

A data package providing access to macroscale structural connectomes of the human brain derived from diffusion MRI via tractography. Includes two datasets: (1) the HCP1065 population-averaged tractography atlas (Yeh 2022, CC BY-SA 4.0) and (2) per-subject TractSeg white matter bundle segmentations from 105 HCP Young Adult subjects (Wasserthal et al. 2018, CC BY-NC 4.0 – non-commercial use only). Both datasets originate from the Human Connectome Project and are subject to the applicable HCP data-use terms. Source TRK files have been converted to R fiber::bundle objects (.rds); no spatial modifications were made to the streamline data.
